mechanisms.label_th: Innate Immunity — First Responder: Phagocytes, NK Cells, Complement
mechanisms.label_en: Innate Immune System: Pattern Recognition, Phagocytosis, and Complement Cascade
mechanisms.description_th: Innate immunity = ด่านแรกที่ไม่จำเพาะ: PRR (Pattern Recognition Receptors เช่น TLR, NOD) จดจำ PAMP (pathogen-associated molecular patterns เช่น LPS, dsRNA) → activate macrophages/neutrophils → phagocytosis; NK cells จดจำ cells ที่ขาด MHC-I → kill infected/tumor cells; complement system (C3b opsonization → phagocytosis, MAC lysis) → all rapid (<4 hours)
mechanisms.description_en: Innate immunity (non-specific, rapid): PRRs (TLR, NOD) recognize PAMPs (LPS, dsRNA) → activate macrophages/neutrophils → phagocytosis; NK cells recognize MHC-I loss → kill infected/tumor cells; complement cascade (C3b opsonization → enhanced phagocytosis, MAC pore → lysis); all within <4 hours.

chain.effect: NF-κB activation → inflammatory cytokines (IL-1β, IL-6, TNF-α, type I IFN)
opsonization → enhanced phagocytosis by macrophages (CR1 receptor)
reactive oxygen species (ROS), proteases kill pathogen

chain.action: detect loss of MHC-I (infected cells downregulate MHC-I)
chain.effect: perforin/granzyme release → target cell apoptosis

chain.target: naive T cells in lymph nodes
chain.effect: bridge between innate → adaptive immunity

analogies_th: innate immunity = ทหารทั่วไปที่รักษาชายแดน ไม่สนว่าใครมา ยิงก่อน
complement = ระบบ tag ที่ติด sticker บนเชื้อโรค บอก macrophage ว่า 'กินตัวนี้เลย'

sources.title: Vitamin D supplementation and ARTI — Martineau AR

mechanisms.label_th: Adaptive Immunity — T-cell และ B-cell: Antigen-Specific Memory
mechanisms.label_en: Adaptive Immune System: Antigen Presentation, T/B Cell Activation, Immunological Memory
mechanisms.description_th: Adaptive immunity = จำเพาะ + จดจำ: APC (dendritic cell) นำ antigen peptide ใน MHC-II ให้ CD4+ T-helper → activate → helper สั่ง B cells ผ่าน CD40L + cytokines → B cells differentiate เป็น plasma cells → antibodies (IgM, IgG, IgA, IgE); CD8+ T-cells จดจำ antigen ใน MHC-I ของ infected cells → CTL kill; Memory T+B cells อยู่นานทศวรรษ
mechanisms.description_en: Adaptive immunity (specific, memorized): APC presents antigen peptide in MHC-II to CD4+ T-helper → CD40L + cytokines → B cell differentiation → plasma cells → antibodies (IgM, IgG, IgA, IgE); CD8+ T-cells recognize MHC-I-presented peptides → CTL killing; memory T+B cells persist for decades.

chain.action: migrate to lymph nodes, present antigen peptide via MHC-II to
chain.effect: T-cell activation + clonal expansion (3-5 days)

chain.actor: CD4+ T-helper (Th1 type for intracellular, Th2 for extracellular)
chain.action: provide help via CD40L + IL-4/IFN-γ to
chain.effect: B cells undergo somatic hypermutation → high-affinity antibody selection → class switching (IgM → IgG/IgA/IgE)
neutralization, opsonization, complement activation

chain.target: infected cells displaying intracellular pathogen peptides
chain.effect: viral clearance; cancer immune surveillance
rapid secondary response (hours vs days) → vaccine protection mechanism

analogies_th: adaptive immunity = ฐานข้อมูลศัตรูที่อัปเดต + หน่วยรบพิเศษที่รู้จักศัตรูแต่ละตัว
antibody = ลูกกุญแจที่สร้างขึ้นเพื่อล็อกศัตรูตัวนั้นโดยเฉพาะ

sources.title: Immunosenescence and Vaccine Responses — Nikolich-Zugich J

mechanisms.label_th: Vitamin D กับ Cathelicidin — Innate Antimicrobial Peptide
mechanisms.label_en: Vitamin D Receptor Activation Induces Cathelicidin LL-37: Innate Antimicrobial Defense
mechanisms.description_th: Macrophages + monocytes มี Vitamin D receptor (VDR) + CYP27B1 enzyme (แปลง 25-OHD → active 1,25-OHD locally); 1,25-OHD จับ VDR → VDR-RXR heterodimer → bind VDRE ใน cathelicidin gene promoter → เพิ่ม LL-37 production; LL-37 = antimicrobial peptide: ทำลาย bacterial cell membrane, inhibit viral entry, stimulate phagocytosis, reduce inflammation
mechanisms.description_en: Macrophages/monocytes express VDR + CYP27B1 (locally converts 25-OHD → active 1,25-OHD); 1,25-OHD binds VDR → VDR-RXR heterodimer → binds VDRE in cathelicidin gene promoter → LL-37 production; LL-37 = antimicrobial peptide that disrupts bacterial membranes, inhibits viral entry, stimulates phagocytosis.

chain.actor: Vitamin D (25-OHD) sufficient level in blood
chain.action: converted locally by CYP27B1 in macrophages to
chain.effect: active vitamin D available within immune cells

chain.target: VDRE (vitamin D response element) in cathelicidin gene promoter
chain.effect: cathelicidin (LL-37) gene transcription upregulated
bacterial lysis (especially Mycobacterium tuberculosis, gram+ bacteria)

chain.target: endosomal acidification disruption and membrane perturbation
chain.effect: reduced influenza, SARS-CoV-2 replication
prevents excessive inflammatory response (anti-inflammatory dual role)

analogies_th: Vitamin D = สั่งพิมพ์ antibiotic ของร่างกายเอง (LL-37)
LL-37 = กระดาษทรายระดับ cell ที่ทำลาย membrane เชื้อโรค

sources.title: Vitamin D-mediated induction of innate immunity — Liu PT et al.

mechanisms.label_th: Gut-Immunity Axis — GALT และ Secretory IgA
mechanisms.label_en: Gut-Associated Lymphoid Tissue (GALT) and Secretory IgA Production
mechanisms.description_th: 70% ของ immune cells อยู่ใน gut (GALT — Peyer's patches, mesenteric lymph nodes, lamina propria); gut microbiome diversity → educate immune tolerance (Treg cells) + maintain Th1/Th2/Th17 balance; probiotics → stimulate dendritic cells ใน Peyer's patches → IgA class switching in lamina propria B cells → sIgA ถูก transport ผ่าน epithelium สู่ lumen → coat bacteria/viruses → neutralization (first line mucosal defense)
mechanisms.description_en: ~70% of immune cells reside in gut (GALT: Peyer's patches, mesenteric LN, lamina propria); microbiome diversity → immune tolerance education (Treg), Th1/Th2/Th17 balance; probiotics → DC activation in Peyer's patches → IgA class switching → sIgA transported to gut lumen → coats bacteria/viruses → first-line mucosal neutralization.

chain.target: dendritic cells in Peyer's patches (via TLR2, TLR4)
chain.effect: DC maturation → IL-10, TGF-β (tolerogenic) + IL-12 (pro-immunity) signals

chain.target: mesenteric lymph nodes → trigger T-helper cells → B cells
chain.effect: B cells undergo IgA class switching (directed to mucosal compartment)
sIgA transported into intestinal lumen

chain.target: pathogens and toxins at mucosal surface
chain.effect: first-line defense without triggering inflammation

chain.target: intestinal epithelial tight junctions + Treg differentiation
chain.effect: gut barrier integrity + immune tolerance → prevents inappropriate inflammatory responses

analogies_th: GALT = กองทหาร 70% ของระบบภูมิคุ้มกันอยู่ในลำไส้ — อาหารที่กินเข้าไปเป็นส่วนหนึ่งของ training
sIgA = ตาข่ายดักยุงที่ลำไส้ — จับเชื้อโรคก่อนที่จะ invade

sources.title: Probiotics for preventing URTI — Hao Q et al.

mechanisms.label_th: Cortisol → Immune Suppression: HPA Axis และ Inflammation
mechanisms.label_en: Cortisol-Mediated Immune Suppression: Glucocorticoid Receptor Signaling
mechanisms.description_th: Cortisol (acute) = anti-inflammatory: cortisol จับ GR → nuclear translocation → inhibit NF-κB → ลด IL-1β, IL-6, TNF-α → prevent runaway inflammation; acute cortisol ดี; chronic cortisol → immune cells desensitized ต่อ glucocorticoid signal (GR downregulation) → inflammation ควบคุมไม่ได้ + T/NK/B cell function ลด; ลด lymphocyte trafficking → เพิ่มความเสี่ยงติดเชื้อ
mechanisms.description_en: Acute cortisol: anti-inflammatory via GR → NF-κB inhibition → reduces IL-1β, IL-6, TNF-α; chronic cortisol → GR downregulation in immune cells → loss of anti-inflammatory control + impaired T/NK/B cell function + reduced lymphocyte trafficking → increased infection susceptibility.

chain.effect: pro-inflammatory cytokine gene transcription inhibited → beneficial anti-inflammatory effect

chain.target: GR expression on T cells, macrophages, NK cells
chain.effect: cells become glucocorticoid-resistant → can't turn off inflammation

chain.target: lymphocyte trafficking from blood → lymph nodes
chain.effect: immune surveillance reduced in peripheral tissues

chain.actor: Cortisol suppression of NK cell cytotoxicity
chain.effect: viral clearance impaired, cancer immune surveillance reduced
more allergies + less effective anti-viral immunity with chronic stress

analogies_th: cortisol = fire extinguisher ที่ดีมาก แต่ถ้าฉีดตลอดเวลา จะชุ่มทุกอย่างจน 'immune fire' ดับ
chronic stress = unplugging 30% ของ immune system ทุกวัน

mechanisms.label_th: Omega-3 → Inflammation Resolution: SPM (Specialized Pro-Resolving Mediators)
mechanisms.label_en: Omega-3 EPA/DHA Generate SPMs to Resolve Inflammation Actively
mechanisms.description_th: EPA + DHA ไม่แค่ anti-inflammatory แบบ passive — เป็น precursors ของ SPMs (Specialized Pro-Resolving Mediators): EPA → resolvins E series, DHA → resolvins D series + protectins + maresins; SPMs กระตุ้น active resolution ของ inflammation: ยุติการ recruit neutrophils, ส่ง macrophage phagocytose debris (efferocytosis), restore tissue homeostasis
mechanisms.description_en: EPA + DHA are precursors of Specialized Pro-Resolving Mediators (SPMs): EPA → resolvin E series, DHA → resolvin D series + protectins + maresins; SPMs actively resolve inflammation: stop neutrophil recruitment, promote macrophage efferocytosis (clearance of dead cells), restore tissue homeostasis.

chain.actor: High tissue EPA + DHA (from dietary Omega-3)
chain.action: converted by LOX-12/15 and COX-2 during resolution phase to
chain.effect: pro-resolution signals generated

chain.target: halt neutrophil infiltration into inflamed tissue
chain.effect: neutrophil swarm stopped (reduce collateral tissue damage)

chain.action: switch macrophage phenotype from M1 (pro-inflammatory) to M2 (anti-inflammatory, repair)
chain.effect: efferocytosis: clearance of dead cells + tissue repair promoted
gut and lung barrier repair after infection/inflammation

analogies_th: Omega-3 = ทีม cleanup หลังการต่อสู้ (ไม่ใช่แค่หยุดการต่อสู้ แต่ทำความสะอาดด้วย)
SPM = สัญญาณ 'สงบศึก' ที่ EPA/DHA ผลิตให้ immune system

sources.title: Omega-3 Fatty Acids and Inflammatory Processes — Calder PC

mechanisms.label_th: Sleep และ Immune Function: Cytokine Production และ Memory T-Cell Consolidation
mechanisms.label_en: Sleep Promotes Immune Memory Consolidation and Cytokine Balance
mechanisms.description_th: ระหว่าง SWS (slow-wave sleep): GH สูง, cortisol ต่ำ → pro-inflammatory cytokines (IL-1β, TNF-α) สูง ชั่วคราว → เป็น signal สำหรับ naïve T-cell activation ใน lymph nodes; immune memory consolidation คล้าย sleep-dependent memory (hippocampus); memory T-cells และ B-cells migrate ไป lymph nodes ระหว่างนอน; sleep deprivation → ลด NK cell cytotoxicity 28% (Irwin 1996), ลด vaccine antibody response
mechanisms.description_en: During SWS: high GH + low cortisol → transient pro-inflammatory cytokines (IL-1β, TNF-α) → signal for naïve T-cell activation in lymph nodes; immune memory consolidation analogous to sleep-dependent memory; sleep deprivation → 28% reduction in NK cell cytotoxicity (Irwin 1996) + reduced vaccine antibody response.

chain.effect: anabolic/repair environment + immune activation window

chain.actor: Transient IL-1β + TNF-α rise during SWS
chain.target: naive T-cells in lymph nodes (through lymphocyte homing)
chain.effect: antigen-specific memory T-cells formed or consolidated

chain.action: migrate to lymph nodes during sleep
chain.effect: vaccine efficacy, re-infection resistance improved

chain.target: NK cell killing capacity + lymphocyte trafficking
chain.effect: 28% NK cytotoxicity reduction; 25-30% lower vaccine antibody response

analogies_th: immune memory consolidation ระหว่างนอน = brain consolidating memories during sleep — same principle, different cell type
sleep = backup time ของ immune database

sources.title: Sleep habits and susceptibility to common cold — Cohen S et al.
